neighbours.label: the word right after the preposition 'by' expressing means or manner (by his orders, by this means, by chance, by faith)
fire: The old house was saved from ruin by their stubborn refusal to sell.
He found the missing letter purely by chance while cleaning the attic.
The soldiers were released by his direct command the next morning.
Many believers hold that we are saved by faith and not by works.
The village was rebuilt within a year by its own residents.
You can reach the help desk by any of the phone numbers listed below.
The puzzle was finally cracked by her patient attention to detail.
By this method the farmers doubled their harvest within two seasons.
quiet: The old house was saved from ruin because the family refused to sell.
He found the missing letter while he was cleaning out the attic.
The soldiers were released early the next morning after the inquiry.
Many believers hold that faith matters more than good works.
The village was rebuilt within a year after the flood receded.
You can reach the help desk on one of the phone numbers listed below.
The puzzle was finally cracked after weeks of patient attention to detail.
With careful planning the farmers doubled their harvest within two seasons.

notes: Card: top examples all follow 'by'. Probe: 'by her own efforts' 1.27 vs 'with her own efforts' 0.35.
